DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV)

The position-dependent vertigo and your age are classic for BPPV, often caused by displaced otoconia in the semicircular canals. While the MRI request was precautionary given your age, the clinical picture strongly points to a mechanical inner ear issue rather than a central cause. Have you noticed any new hearing loss, tinnitus, or ear fullness in the affected ear during these episodes?
